title: Obstruct arbitrary-curve tracking without negating endpoint control
statement: Let smooth solenoidal psi be L2-orthogonal to the12 fundamental ordinary force fields. For disturbance-free weak solution U and smooth curve V with sup_(0<=t<=T)||U-V||2<=epsilon,weak testing and convection cancellation give |integral_0^T <V_t-nu Delta V+B(V,V),psi>dt|<=2epsilon||psi||2+Tnu epsilon||Delta psi||2+Tepsilon(2sup_t||V||2+epsilon)||grad psi||infinity. The force cancels regardless of amplitude or speed. Take constant nonfundamental shear V=e1 cos(2kappa x2) times any fixed positive amplitude and psi=V/||V||2. B(V,V)=0,so the left side is Tnu(2kappa)²||V||2>0 while the right side tends0 as epsilon tends0. Thus a positive whole-interval tracking floor remains even with initial U0=V. This is not a fixed-time endpoint obstruction and does not refute the supplied exact12-force common endpoint compiler.
